# @rockshin/tao-ui

> A component library for React 18.2 and 19 with semantic DOM customization and OKLCH-based theming.

## Install

```bash
npm install @rockshin/tao-ui
```

Peer dependencies: `react ^18.2.0 || ^19.0.0`, `react-dom ^18.2.0 || ^19.0.0`. Minimum version: React and React DOM 18.2; React 19 is also supported.
`dayjs` is a regular dependency and is installed automatically.
Import components from subpaths such as `@rockshin/tao-ui/button` and `TaoProvider` from `@rockshin/tao-ui/provider` to load only their component dependencies and shared theme styles. No separate CSS import is needed.
The package root remains available and includes all component styles.

## Core Concepts

- `TaoProvider` supplies size, disabled, variant, portal scope, and theme seed token defaults.
- Components expose semantic DOM customization through `classNames` and `styles` props.
- Theme tokens are CSS custom properties prefixed with `--tao-*`; import `tokenVar(name)` and `taoTokenNames` from `@rockshin/tao-ui/tokens`.
- Import `componentDocs` and `getComponentDoc(name)` from `@rockshin/tao-ui/meta` for machine-readable component metadata.
- Resolve `@rockshin/tao-ui/component-manifest.json` for plain JSON without loading component code.
- [Agent guide](https://rickyshin93.github.io/tao-ui/guide/agents.md): read contracts, choose imports, and verify generated code.
- [Website discovery index](https://rickyshin93.github.io/tao-ui/agent-manifest.json): current website version and bilingual Markdown/API links. Match it to your installed version.

## Component Groups

- Config: App, TaoProvider
- Data Display: Avatar, Badge, Calendar, Card, Carousel, Collapse, Descriptions, Empty, Image, List, Listy, Masonry, Popover, QRCode, ScrollArea, Statistic, Table, Tag, Timeline, Tooltip, Tree
- Data Entry: AutoComplete, Cascader, Checkbox, ColorPicker, DatePicker, Form, FormActions, FormField, FormSection, Input, InputNumber, Mentions, Radio, RangePicker, Rate, Segmented, Select, Slider, Switch, Textarea, TimePicker, Transfer, TreeSelect, Upload
- Feedback: Alert, Drawer, Modal, Popconfirm, Progress, Result, Skeleton, Sonner, Spinner, Tour
- General: BorderBeam, Button, FloatButton, Watermark
- Headless: HeadlessInputNumber
- Layout: Divider, FormLayout, Splitter, Stack
- Navigation: Affix, Breadcrumb, ContextMenu, Dropdown, Pagination, Steps, Tabs

## Components

### Affix

Affixes content to a window or scroll container boundary.

- Category: Navigation
- Exports: `Affix`
- Source: `src/components/affix/affix.tsx`
- Storybook: `stories/affix.stories.tsx`
- Tests: `tests/affix/affix.test.tsx`
- Semantic parts: `root`, `content`

Affixes content to a window or scroll container boundary.

### Alert

Displays important contextual feedback messages with semantic status types.

- Category: Feedback
- Exports: `Alert`
- Source: `src/components/alert/alert.tsx`
- Storybook: `stories/alert.stories.tsx`
- Tests: `tests/alert/alert.test.tsx`
- Semantic parts: `root`, `icon`, `title`, `description`, `action`, `close`

Use Alert for persistent, page-level feedback about a state or operation. Use Sonner toasts for transient notifications.

### App

Scopes imperative messages, notifications and confirmation dialogs to the current React tree and TaoProvider theme.

- Category: Config
- Exports: `App`
- Source: `src/components/app/app.tsx`
- Storybook: `stories/app.stories.tsx`
- Tests: `tests/app/app.test.tsx`
- Semantic parts: `root`

Place App below TaoProvider, then call App.useApp() from descendant components. Messages return callable close handles that can be awaited; confirmation dialogs return update, destroy and then.

### AutoComplete

Editable text input with searchable suggestions, keyboard completion and custom input support.

- Category: Data Entry
- Exports: `AutoComplete`
- Source: `src/components/auto-complete/auto-complete.tsx`
- Storybook: `stories/auto-complete.stories.tsx`
- Tests: `tests/auto-complete/auto-complete.test.tsx`
- Semantic parts: `root`, `prefix`, `input`, `placeholder`, `content`, `clear`, `popup.root`, `popup.list`, `popup.listItem`

Use AutoComplete when free-form input is valid and suggestions help users finish typing.

### Avatar

Represents people with images, icons or automatically fitted initials.

- Category: Data Display
- Exports: `Avatar`
- Source: `src/components/avatar/avatar.tsx`
- Storybook: `stories/avatar.stories.tsx`
- Tests: `tests/avatar/avatar.test.tsx`
- Semantic parts: `root`, `image`, `icon`, `content`

Use Avatar for a person or account; group related people with Avatar.Group.

- Tests: `tests/badge/badge.test.tsx`
- Semantic parts: `root`, `indicator`

### Breadcrumb

Renders the user location in a hierarchy of pages or views.

- Category: Navigation
- Exports: `Breadcrumb`
- Source: `src/components/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.tsx`
- Storybook: `stories/breadcrumb.stories.tsx`
- Tests: `tests/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.test.tsx`
- Semantic parts: `root`, `list`, `item`, `link`, `page`, `separator`, `ellipsis`

Use Breadcrumb near the top of a page when users need to understand or move through nested context.

### Button

Triggers an immediate action such as submitting, saving, or opening a surface.

- Category: General
- Exports: `Button`
- Source: `src/components/button/button.tsx`
- Storybook: `stories/button.stories.tsx`
- Tests: `tests/button/button.test.tsx`
- Semantic parts: `root`

Use Button for explicit actions. It inherits size, disabled, and variant defaults from TaoProvider.

Use Card for a distinct content item; Card.Meta organizes its identity and description.

### Cascader

### Checkbox

- Tests: `tests/checkbox/checkbox.test.tsx`

Use Checkbox for independent choices, or CheckboxGroup when users can select multiple options from a set.

### Collapse

Groups content into accessible item-based panels with built-in headers, expand icons and accordion behavior.

- Category: Data Display
- Exports: `Collapse`
- Source: `src/components/collapse/collapse.tsx`
- Storybook: `stories/collapse.stories.tsx`
- Tests: `tests/collapse/collapse.test.tsx`, `tests/collapse/panels.test.tsx`
- Semantic parts: `root`, `item`, `header`, `trigger`, `title`, `icon`, `extra`, `content`, `body`

Pass items with key, label and children for ready-to-use panels; use accordion to allow one open panel and activeKey/onChange for controlled state.

### ColorPicker

Choose single or gradient colors with hex, RGB, HSB and alpha controls.

- Category: Data Entry
- Exports: `ColorPicker`
- Source: `src/components/color-picker/color-picker.tsx`
- Storybook: `stories/color-picker.stories.tsx`
- Tests: `tests/color-picker/color-picker.test.tsx`
- Semantic parts: `root`, `body`, `content`, `description`, `popup.root`, `popup.container`

Keep the returned Color object when precision matters and call toCssString for use in CSS.

Use DatePicker when free text date input would be error-prone or when users benefit from calendar context.

### Form

Collects and validates field values with an antd-aligned API (rules, dependencies, Form.List) on top of the rc-form engine.

- Category: Data Entry
- Exports: `Form`
- Source: `src/components/form/form.tsx`
- Storybook: `stories/form.stories.tsx`
- Tests: `tests/form/form.test.tsx`, `tests/form/form-scroll.test.tsx`
- Semantic parts: `root`

Use Form with Form.Item when fields need a value store, rule validation, or submit handling. Use the lighter FormField when you manage state yourself.

Use the headless API when tao-ui styling is not appropriate but number formatting behavior should stay consistent.

Use Modal for focused tasks or decisions. Static helpers such as Modal.confirm mirror common confirmation flows.

- Semantic parts: `root`, `item`, `total`

Use Pagination when a collection is split into pages rather than infinitely loaded.

### Popconfirm

Shows a compact confirmation popup anchored to a trigger element, with OK and Cancel actions.

- Category: Feedback
- Exports: `Popconfirm`
- Source: `src/components/popconfirm/popconfirm.tsx`
- Storybook: `stories/popconfirm.stories.tsx`
- Tests: `tests/popconfirm/popconfirm.test.tsx`
- Semantic parts: `content`, `title`, `description`, `footer`, `icon`

Use Popconfirm for lightweight inline confirmations such as delete actions, where a full Modal would be too heavy. Use Modal.confirm for critical or complex confirmations.

### Popover

Displays a floating card with rich content anchored to a trigger element, opened by click or hover.

- Category: Data Display
- Exports: `Popover`
- Source: `src/components/popover/popover.tsx`
- Storybook: `stories/popover.stories.tsx`
- Tests: `tests/popover/popover.test.tsx`
- Semantic parts: `root`, `container`, `title`, `content`, `arrow`

Use Popover for rich, non-blocking contextual content behind a click or hover. Use Tooltip for short text-only hints and Modal for blocking interactions.

- Source: `src/components/sonner/sonner.tsx`

- Tests: `tests/sonner/sonner.test.tsx`
- Semantic parts: `viewport`, `toast`, `content`, `title`, `description`, `actions`, `action`, `cancel`, `close`

Mount one Sonner near app root, then call toast() imperatively from event handlers. Supports toast.loading(), toast.promise(), and toast.custom() for richer async and custom notification flows.

## Notes For Code Generation

- Prefer component subpaths for smaller imports; the root entry remains supported.
- Customize internals through semantic `classNames` and `styles`, not private class names.
- Prefer provider-level defaults for app-wide size, disabled, variant, and theme choices.
- Use `Modal.useModal()` inside React components so dialogs inherit the surrounding provider context.
